title: Large Multi-Generational Family Gathering, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A comprehensive multi-generational family portrait taken indoors during an anniversary or family celebration circa 1950. Several generations are arranged in tiers: young children sit cross-legged and kneeling on the floor in front, elderly family members and honored guests wearing floral corsages and boutonnières sit across the middle row, and dozens of adult relatives stand closely packed in the background against wood-paneled walls. The clothing reflects post-WWII American styles with wide-lapel suits, patterned neckties, tailored dresses, eyeglasses, and curled hairstyles.
